# pve_ceph_stop (Action)

Stop Ceph services on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ceph_stop" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ceph_stop.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `service` (String) Ceph service name. (default: ceph.target)
